def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car parked on the road")
    playground_patches = image_patch.find("playground")

    if not car_patches or not playground_patches:
        return []

    car_playground_distance = min(distance(car, playground) for car in car_patches for playground in playground_patches)

    next_to_playground_cars = [car for car in car_patches if abs(distance(car, playground) - car_playground_distance) < 10]

    return next_to_playground_cars
